_about: Dimethyl carbonate (1) + Methyl acetate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 93.13 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of dimethyl carbonate, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: N. A. Mali, S. S. Yadav, P. D. Ghuge, S. S. Joshi, Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Data for Binary Mixtures of Dimethyl Carbonate with Methyl Acetate, Ethyl Acetate, n-Propyl Acetate, Isopropyl Acetate, n-Butyl Acetate, and Isoamyl Acetate at 93.13 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 4356-4363
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 22, 23. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.17 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
